snippet.title: Mourning Tide - Official Release Date Trailer!
snippet.description:
A fishing horror game set on the tides of horror.

A guilt-ridden fisherman sails into forbidden waters. With every catch, the echoes of his life rise to the surface. Unravel the past, seek redemption’s light, or be consumed by the Mourning Tide. 

With a release date locked in and excitement growing, let's take a peek at what Mourning Tide hides beneath the inky waters of this ocean of regret...
